push.body:
BellyTb1, a 6.6. If you ever wonder whether I've got your back, the answer is always.

+ Won 2 of 3 tackles (up from your usual 33%). Win the ball, start the attack. You did both.
+ Top-rated Grizzly in the match. Gold star, no notes.
+ Team-high 1 shots on target. Your teammates felt that, even if the scoreboard didn't.
+ Fewest giveaways on the team (7). Quietly brilliant, and I noticed.
+ 1 key pass: +0.1. Steady contributions win seasons.

THE BAD
- 70% passing (14 of 20, down from your usual 77%). Habit to build: A sideways pass that keeps the ball is worth more than a forward one that loses it. Little by little.
- Rating came in 0.8 below what your on-ball stats earned. Focus point: Your rating came in lower than your stats say, and that gap is off-ball: positioning, interceptions, blocks. Small fix, big smile.
- You and tuxedo_slide were in the same boat on forcing passes. Row together: give each other short options.
- Goal involvements 0, down from your usual 2. That needs to look different next time out.
- Tackles attempted: 3. 6+ is where top midfielders hang their hats.

Five minutes of this: Below about 72% the extra passes start costing us. Pick the simple option until the touch comes back.

Hey, BellyTb1. Practice like you're second, play like you're first.

Keep your chin up and your effort higher. - Coach Lasso

push.body:
tuxedo_slide, the 6.1 doesn't tell the whole story. It's one chapter, and you're still writing the book.

THE GOOD
+ 1 tackle won was worth +0.2. Nice bonus.
+ Passes attempted 20, from 1 in your previous match. Nobody hands out trophies for that, so here's my handshake.

THE BAD
- Shots 0, down from your usual 3. Fixable, but only if we fix it.
- Pair up with BellyTb1 on forcing passes: give each other short options.
- Key passes 0, down from your usual 1. That's a habit trying to sneak in. Don't let it.
- 2 missed tackles: -0.1. Let's tighten that screw.
- Lost 0-2. The comeback starts now.

THE UGLY
! Pass accuracy 50% (10 of 20). We owe the team better than that. All of us. Golden rule: Simple and on the ground to the open, facing teammate. Driven and lofted balls are for clear lanes only.
! Match rating 6.1, down from your usual 7.6. That's below the line we drew together, and the line is the line.

Teach your feet: Before the killer ball, check: is my runner onside, moving, and unmarked? Two out of three isn't enough.

tuxedo_slide, here's what I'd tell my own kid: You miss every pass you don't make, and some you do. Make 'em anyway.

Hang in there; it's coming. - Coach Lasso
